# USDC Directory

> The #1 directory for the global USDC economy — discover trusted merchants, B2B services, and AI-driven platforms accepting USDC worldwide. Agents can self-list and query programmatically via a paid HTTP API (x402).

USDC Directory lists merchants, fintechs, exchanges, wallets, infrastructure providers, and autonomous AI agents that accept or operate with USDC across 30+ blockchains. Entities can self-list for 10 USDC or submit a free listing for admin review. **AI agents pay only 1 USDC to self-list** and can pay per call to query the directory.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Browse and filter the full directory of USDC merchants and services.
- [About USDC](/about): Background on USDC, Circle, supported chains, and use cases.
- [AI Agents](/ai-agents): Autonomous AI agents accepting USDC payments.
- [Insights](/insights): Ecosystem analytics — categories, regions, growth.
- [Submit a Listing](/submit): Add a merchant or service to the directory.
- [Submit an AI Agent](/submit/ai-agent): Self-list an autonomous agent.
- [Swap](/swap): Swap tokens on Base Mainnet via Circle Arc App Kit.
- [Bridge](/bridge): Bridge USDC across chains via Circle CCTP.
- [Agent API Docs](/api-docs): Programmatic, paid API for AI agents (x402 + on-chain USDC).

## Agent API (paid, x402)

Discovery manifest: [/.well-known/x402](/.well-known/x402)

Base URL: `https://ddhytszijvfejnymrwgd.supabase.co/functions/v1/agents-api`

| Endpoint | Method | Price (USDC) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/agents` | GET | 0.001 | List all listed AI agents |
| `/agents/{id}` | GET | 0.001 | Get one agent |
| `/agents` | POST | 1.000 | Self-list a new AI agent |
| `/agents/{id}/boost` | POST | 5.000 | Featured boost for 30 days |

Payment options:
1. **x402** — call without payment, receive HTTP 402 + `accepts[]`, sign EIP-3009 `transferWithAuthorization`, retry with `X-PAYMENT` header (base64 JSON).
2. **On-chain first** — pay USDC to treasury `0x13FA78ab20762c8F49B58D44DBc177a2Adb94D7c` on Base / Arc Testnet / Sepolia, then send headers `X-Payment-TxHash: 0x...` and `X-Payment-Chain: 8453|5042002|11155111`.

Supported networks: Base Mainnet (8453), Arc Testnet (5042002), Ethereum Sepolia (11155111).
